signal: Alianza completed its Metaswitch acquisition from Microsoft and unveiled its Intelligent Communications Fabric, with plans to grow the sales team 400%

email.body1:
Ali, saw Alianza close the Metaswitch acquisition and launch the Intelligent Communications Fabric.

Growth like that, plus the plan to grow the sales team 400%, usually surfaces more in-market service providers than reps can cover before they ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alianza off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ali, quick follow-up for Alianza.

With Metaswitch folded in and the team scaling fast, pipeline targets usually climb faster than new reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alianza needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ali, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alianza's reply rate likely compares to other communications platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ali, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and integrating Metaswitch while scaling the team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Alianza either way.
